evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have

observations.why: Directive establishes a recurring future cadence and frames an unrehearsed rollback as a hypothetical gap, generalizing into an abstract principle of operational readiness.
Labels a specific planned recurring activity — a concrete future cadence tied to a named artifact.
Asserts the current, settled assignment of a named individual to a concrete role.
